description: Land Acquisition - Veddukadu, Punakari D/S Division, Kilinochchi  District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including descriptions of land lots, extents, boundaries, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), this is only in his capacity as the authority making the declaration under the Land Act, not as a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The core content is exclusively about land acquisition, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
